subject: Consolidating sandbox grant + pricing carve-out request for InnovateHub cohort
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah@innovatehub.co>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidation of sandbox grants + pricing carve-out?

Hi Mateo,

Hope you're well — thanks again for the intro call last week. Quick ask from our finance + founder teams: InnovateHub ran two accelerator cohorts this year and each cohort received a separate sandbox grant (non-transferrable) from Redwood. We have a small group of portfolio startups that will be moving from sandbox into early production and it'd be hugely helpful if we could consolidate the leftover sandbox credits (totaling approximately $12,000) and either: 1) apply them to a single incubator account that will soon convert to a Dedicated instance, or 2) convert a portion into a one-time promotional discount on the first month of Dedicated.

Key constraints from our side:
- We can't onboard each startup individually for the Dedicated promotion — need a consolidated path.
- We need credits to be usable within 90 days of consolidation.
- Finance prefers a simple one-page addendum rather than complex invoicing changes.

I attached a short summary of the grant balances (sandbox-grant-summary.pdf). Is there a way Redwood can make a one-off exception for accelerator cohorts here? If you can outline options, I can share with our CFO and Samir (cc'd) at Accelerate.VC.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Lee
Head of Programs, InnovateHub
hannah@innovatehub.co
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah@innovatehub.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidation of sandbox grants + pricing carve-out?

Hi Hannah — appreciate the clear summary and the file. I reviewed the grant breakdown and this is something we can often handle with a manual exception, but it depends on the mechanics (transfer vs. conversion to a promo).

Proposed path for quick alignment:
1) Consolidate the $12k of remaining sandbox credits into a single InnovateHub-managed sandbox account (one-time operation).
2) Offer a one-time conversion option: up to 50% of consolidated credits may be converted into a Dedicated onboarding credit (applied against first 3 months) OR we provide an equivalent promotional discount applied to the invoice for the first billing period.
3) Attach a two-paragraph MSA addendum capturing the portability window (90 days) and clawback conditions if the account is not activated.

Ben/Vanessa — can you confirm pricing flexibility here? I'm attaching a quick pricing sketch (proposed-pricing-sheet.xlsx) with two variants: 15% discount applied vs. credit conversion. If finance/legal are fine with a short addendum, we can route this as a sales exception rather than a full contract rewrite.

Hannah — if that sounds good I can pull together a short addendum and route for signature. If you'd prefer a committed reserved conversion instead (12mo), we can do a deeper discount tier as a second option.

Best,
Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidation of sandbox grants + pricing carve-out?

Thanks for the ping, Mateo. Quick pricing guidance from rev/proc:
- We can approve a manual consolidation and permit conversion of up to 50% of the consolidated $12k into onboarding credits applied to billing, no questions, as a one-off sales exception.
- Standalone promotional discount: up to 15% off list for the first 3 months if they convert to a pay-as-you-go Dedicated account.
- If InnovateHub agrees to a committed 12-month reserved capacity (min commit $18k ARR), escalate to 25% off first-year consumption pricing and we can convert 100% of the $12k into a credit against the commit.

Risks/requirements:
- Need a signed addendum that defines credit portability and the 90-day redemption window.
- Finance needs to see an approved HubSpot deal + billing contact; Lauren can confirm accounting path (credit on invoice vs. promo code).
- Legal will need to sign off on a short addendum; attaching suggested term language (redwood-term-addendum.docx).

If we want to keep it fast, I recommend: Consolidate into InnovateHub-managed sandbox + allow 50% conversion to onboarding credits and 15% promo for toggling to pay-as-you-go. If they commit to 12mo reserved, we replace with the higher-tier offer.

Ben
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah@innovatehub.co>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidation of sandbox grants + pricing carve-out?

Hi Hannah — thanks for the note and for sharing the balances. Following Ben's guidance and Mateo's sketch, Redwood can make the following exception for InnovateHub: 

1) Consolidate up to $12,000 of sandbox credits into a single InnovateHub-managed sandbox account (we'll carry over existing expiration dates and set a 90-day activation window).
2) One-time conversion: up to 50% ($6,000) may be converted into onboarding credits applied to the first 3 months of a Dedicated deployment (applied as invoice credits).
3) Promotional option: 18% off list for the first 3 billing cycles if they go pay-as-you-go (we can do 18% as a middle ground between 15%/25%).
4) If InnovateHub signs a 12-month reserved capacity deal (minimum $18k ARR), Redwood will convert 100% of the $12k grant into a credit against the committed spend and apply a 25% ramp discount on usage pricing for the first year.

Next steps:
- I will prep a 1-page addendum for signature (we'll use the standard MSA addendum template + the clause about 90-day portability).
- Lauren — please confirm the invoice mechanics (credit vs promo).
- Hannah — if you can confirm which option InnovateHub prefers (convert 50% now OR take the 18% promo OR pursue the 12mo commit path), we'll have the addendum ready for signature. Attach: redwood-tcpa-draft.docx (legal placeholder).

Note: Quoting Mateo's earlier point for context:
On Thu, May 18, 2028 at 10:03 AM Mateo Alvarez wrote:
> Consolidate the $12k of remaining sandbox credits into a single InnovateHub-managed sandbox account (one-time operation).
> Offer a one-time conversion option: up to 50% of consolidated credits may be converted into a Dedicated onboarding credit...

Appreciate the quick confirmation so we can close this this week.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Date: 2028-05-21T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidation of sandbox grants + pricing carve-out?

Hi Vanessa / Mateo — thanks for the clear options and the addendum draft. InnovateHub will proceed with option 1 + conversion: consolidate the $12k and convert 50% ($6k) into onboarding credits applied to the first billing period when we spin up the Dedicated instance. We will evaluate the committed path with our portfolio and follow up if any startups want the 12mo reserved option.

Please route the 1-page addendum to me and cc our finance contact (billing@innovatehub.co). Also confirm the 90-day clock starts at consolidation date. Once the addendum is signed we'll schedule the activation window and provide the billing contact for the Dedicated conversion.

Thanks again — Hannah
